plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Occupational Safety & Health, Certificate - 18 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25; Effective Date: 08/24; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Genuine catalog quirks kept verbatim: the map prints 'OSHA 1928 or OSHA 1927' paired with 'Fundamentals of Occupations Safety & Health General Industry or Fundamental of Occupational Safety and Health Construction Industry' (the AAS map abbreviates these as 'Fundamentals of OSH General Industry' / 'Fundamentals of OSH Construction Industry'); 'OSHA 1932 Work Practices Controls/Safety Audits' (AAS prints 'Work Practices Control/Safety Audits').
